_readme: The owner's Science lessons (refactor Phase 2.5 step G). Run: python tools/quiz-maker-v2/seed_lessons.py tools/quiz-maker-v2/seeds/science.json (add --rewrite <group> to write a grade's existing lessons again, for example after changing titles). A lesson is a title or {title, quiz, assignment}; existing lessons are kept unless rewritten. The teacher fills them in on «دروسي»; he cannot rename, add or delete them. 3rd Prep: the teacher's list of 2026-11-23 (4 units, the same 4 parts each; only the exams have a quiz; no assignments). 1st Secondary: numbered placeholders until its list comes.
